entities.summary: Garrett Nicholas Cooper is an American former professional baseball first baseman and right fielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Yankees, Miami Marlins, San Diego Padres, Chicago Cubs, and Boston Red Sox. Cooper was an All-Star in 2022.
